Subject: Aligning on next demo window and attendee roster

Hi Sasha / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: We covered your main goals (lower inference latency for the patient search autocomplete, reduce per-request cost for batch exports, and enable private deployment for PHI).
- Outcome: Team is interested in a technical deep-dive + ops run-through that includes engineering, infra, and procurement.

Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep-dive with demos (runtime, KV caching, quantization tradeoffs) + Q&A.

Would any of these windows work on your side (all in PT)?
1) Wed Apr 1, 10:00–11:00am PT
2) Wed Apr 1, 2:00–3:00pm PT
3) Thu Apr 2, 9:00–10:00am PT

Please confirm preferred slot and a short attendee roster (name + role). On our side I’ll bring Ben (solutions engineer) and Diego (runtime engineer).

I attached a short draft agenda and a tech appendix for context. Once you confirm the time and attendees I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom bridge and the meeting agenda.

Thanks —
Evelyn

evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0132

Evelyn — thanks for the summary and the materials. Quick responses: 

- All three proposed topics look on point. We want the deep-dive to focus on: 1) live autocomplete latency showing prefix caching impact, and 2) batch export throughput with quantized models.
- Attendees (internal):
  * Carlos Mendez — CTO (will join for architecture questions)
  * Sasha Turner — Product (I'll drive the session)
  * Priya Narang — Senior Backend Engineer (PK, will be hands-on)

Time: Thu Apr 2, 9:00–10:00am PT works best for us. Priya is on call Tue/Wed so Thu is ideal.

Can you include a short runbook in the agenda (what logs/metrics we'll need to look at) so Priya can prep access? Also, we prefer Zoom if possible — will need a passcode in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sasha
